names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ευστάθιος, Θεσπέσιος και Ανατόλιος», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 20 ноября ст. ст., name page 2280, «Феспесий Никейский, мч.», with the rank word left off; the line itself declines the bare forename. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

death.note: The interval is widened to hold both readings and neither is narrowed. saint.gr gave «Οι Άγιοι Ευστάθιος, Θεσπέσιος και Ανατόλιος έζησαν στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Μαξιμιανού το έτος 300», on which this folder held 300 flat. days.pravoslavie.ru gives 312 twice, in the line for 20 ноября ст. ст. and at the close of its life page, «(+ 312)». Neither page gives a year of birth, and no page read gives a reason to prefer either year.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 ноября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Евстафия, Феспесия и Анатолия (312).»

attestations.note: The year the Russian gives, «(312)», is twelve years later than the 300 this folder held off saint.gr. Both are in `dates`, neither is narrowed, and the `display` no longer names one year.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ευστάθιος, Θεσπέσιος και Ανατόλιος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3052/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The line enumerates three brothers by name, so there is a folder for each, and the three share one life. The corpus keeps `thespesius` on the Greek 1 June, a different man on a different day, so the display name takes the day. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
